_comment: Timing-coupled sites in the portal's vitest suite (portal/src/**/*.test.ts)
that scripts/check_vitest_test_flakiness.py has seen and that are ACCEPTED.
The checker fails on any site not listed here, and equally on any entry here
that no longer matches a site -- a stale allowance is how a ban quietly stops
The third sibling of docs/test-flakiness.json (Go) and
contract, same kind-in-the-key reasoning -- see docs/60-test-flakiness.md.
This one is EMPTY, and that is the intended steady state rather than a gap:
the suite's one real-clock setTimeout (Flow.test.ts, asserting the
dropped-count chip stayed absent) was rewritten onto src/testing.ts
staysAbsent rather than recorded, the same repair the Go sweep made onto
StaysFalse and the Python one onto stays_empty. `bare-sleep` and
`long-sleep` are both defined as kinds a future site could land in; neither
has an entry today because none should be needed for the one shape this
suite actually has (a negative assertion), which staysAbsent already covers.
